title: Code: compute confidence intervals by formula

cues.en: Instructor: Now that you know the theory of computing, confidence intervals based on that formula that I showed you in the previous slide, it is time to see that in practice.
cues.zh: 講師：知道如何用前一張公式計算信賴區間後，現在看實作。

cues.en: And this will also help you conceptualize the idea of what confidence intervals mean and what they don't mean.
cues.zh: 也有助理解信賴區間代表什麼、不代表什麼。

cues.en: So let's get started.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: We're going to simulate some population data.
cues.zh: 模擬一些母體資料。

cues.en: So here I generate a population of data and we are just pretending.
cues.zh: 這裡產生母體，我們只是假裝。

cues.en: Now we're assuming that this is the entire, entire population that we care about.
cues.zh: 假設這是所有關心的完整母體。

cues.en: It's 10 million data points.
cues.zh: 有 1000 萬個資料點。

cues.en: I say lots and lots data, I guess that's relative it 10 million points may or may not be a lot of data, but it doesn't matter.
cues.zh: 我寫很多很多資料，但這是相對的，1000 萬可能多，也可能不多，不重要。

cues.en: So we simulate 10 million data points one times 10 to the seven and the data are non normally distributed, which is actually not important for this particular example
cues.zh: 模擬 1000 萬個點，1×10⁷，資料非常態分布，對這個信賴區間計算

cues.en: of computing confidence intervals.
cues.zh: 範例其實不重要。

cues.en: But you know, I like to change things up a bit when we simulate data.
cues.zh: 只是模擬時喜歡變化一下。

cues.en: So here we compute the mean of the population.
cues.zh: 這裡計算母體平均。

cues.en: So we know the exact population parameter.
cues.zh: 知道精確母體參數。

cues.en: Of course, in practice in real data, you don't know the exact population parameter.
cues.zh: 真實資料中，實際上當然不知道。

cues.en: This is the unknown.
cues.zh: 這是未知量。

cues.en: But here again, is another advantage of simulating data for understanding statistics.
cues.zh: 再次呈現模擬資料理解統計的優點。

cues.en: We can see whether the population mean is actually contained inside the confidence interval of our sample mean.
cues.zh: 可以看母體平均，是否真的包含在樣本平均的信賴區間中。

cues.en: And remember from the previous video that we are not guarantee the confidence interval doesn't guarantee that the population parameter
cues.zh: 記住，區間不保證母體參數

cues.en: is going to be within the lower and upper bounds.
cues.zh: 一定在上下界之間。

cues.en: If that's still a little bit confusing, then don't worry, just focus on computing confidence intervals for now.
cues.zh: 若仍困惑，不用擔心，目前專注計算。

cues.en: In the last video of this section, I'm gonna talk more about common misconceptions and misinterpretations of confidence intervals.
cues.zh: 本章最後影片，會多談常見誤解。

cues.en: Anyway, let's see, here I'm plotting the data.
cues.zh: 這裡畫資料。

cues.en: Now here's a little, it's not really a trick, but something that's often useful to do if you have a lot of data and you want to visualize them, instead of visualizing every single data point
cues.zh: 有個不算技巧、但資料多時常有用的做法，不必呈現每個資料點，

cues.en: that might get either difficult to look at or just taxing for your computer's graphics card, you can plot every nth data point.
cues.zh: 因為可能難看清，或讓顯示卡負荷大；可以每隔 n 個點畫一個。

cues.en: So here I'm plotting every thousandth data point.
cues.zh: 這裡每 1000 個點畫一個。

cues.en: So it's gonna just, reduce the amounts of data that we're showing.

cues.en: So again, this is the population histogram.
cues.zh: 同樣，這是母體直方圖。

cues.en: In fact, this is a sample because we're just plotting a subset of the data.
cues.zh: 其實是樣本，因為只畫部分資料。

cues.en: Now what we're going to do is draw a random sample from our population.
cues.zh: 接著從母體抽隨機樣本。

cues.en: So we're going to compute the mean of a sample of 40.
cues.zh: 計算大小 40 的樣本平均。

cues.en: So we're gonna sample randomly 40 of these elements and then we're gonna compute a 95% confidence interval around that mean.
cues.zh: 隨機抽 40 個元素，再計算平均周圍的 95% 信賴區間。

cues.en: So here I pick some random integer, and this is the way that we are going to randomly select data.
cues.zh: 隨機整數，就是隨機選資料的方式。

cues.en: Here I compute the mean and the standard deviation.
cues.zh: 計算平均和標準差。

cues.en: And of course I'm saving both of these as variables because we need those in the formula for the confidence intervals.
cues.zh: 儲存為變數，因為公式要用。

cues.en: So here we get the confidence.
cues.zh: 這裡取得信賴水準。

cues.en: So this was in the slides, I forget exactly what was the notation that I used, but remember that a 95% confidence interval means
cues.zh: 忘了投影片用什麼記號，但 95% 信賴區間表示，

cues.en: that we want 2.5% on the left of the T distribution and 2.5% on the right of the T distribution.
cues.zh: t 分布左側 2.5%、右側 2.5%。

cues.en: So here, let me close this so you can see all this line of code.
cues.zh: 關閉這個，讓你看到整行。

cues.en: So I am computing the confidence intervals as the sample mean plus T inverse.
cues.zh: 計算樣本平均加上 t 反函式。

cues.en: So the inverse of the T distribution these two numbers here.
cues.zh: t 分布反函式，輸入這兩個數字。

cues.en: So citmp, confidence interval tmp, and one minus confidence interval tmp.
cues.zh: citmp，信賴區間暫存值，以及 1−citmp。

cues.en: This is 2.5% and 97.5% of the T distribution based
cues.zh: 就是根據信賴水準，取 t 分布的 2.5% 和 97.5%

cues.en: on our confidence interval here.
cues.zh: 位置。

cues.en: And then we have N minus one degrees of freedom for this T distribution.
cues.zh: t 分布有 N−1 個自由度。

cues.en: And then this is that T star value that I showed.
cues.zh: 這就是展示過的 t 星號。

cues.en: And that gets multiplied by the sample standard deviation S divided by the square root of N.
cues.zh: 乘以樣本標準差 s 除以 √N。

cues.en: So there you go, that is our confidence interval there.
cues.zh: 這就是信賴區間。

cues.en: And here I'm going to graph everything.
cues.zh: 再把所有內容畫出來。

cues.en: So let's see what everything is.
cues.zh: 看看每一項。

cues.en: And just show you this graph first.
cues.zh: 先展示圖。

cues.en: So here, okay, so this is actually pretty cool.
cues.zh: 這其實很酷。

cues.en: We see in this dashed black line up here is the true mean we now we have the access
cues.zh: 上面的黑色虛線是真正平均，我們能存取

cues.en: to the entire population so we can compute the true mean.
cues.zh: 整個母體，所以能計算真正平均。

cues.en: And then I have the sample mean here in red, which turn out to be remarkably close to the true mean.
cues.zh: 紅色是樣本平均，結果和真正平均驚人地接近。

cues.en: And then here in this green region, it looks like a box, but it's just a polygon that I've drawn around this using the patch function.
cues.zh: 綠色區域看起來像方框，但只是用 patch 在周圍畫的多邊形。

cues.en: This is the 95% confidence interval around the sample mean.
cues.zh: 這是樣本平均的 95% 信賴區間。

cues.en: So in this case it also does include the true mean, but you know, just before I started recording, I ran through all this code once just to make sure I can talk about it and sound intelligent.

cues.en: And I happened to get this finding.

cues.en: But it's interesting to see, oh, that one was pretty close.
cues.zh: 有趣，喔，那個很接近。

cues.en: It's interesting to see that the 95% confidence interval is varying.
cues.zh: 可以看到，95% 區間一直變化。

cues.en: Sometimes it's a little bit wider and sometimes it's a little bit narrower.
cues.zh: 有時寬些，有時窄些。

cues.en: And that's because this number doesn't change.
cues.zh: 因為這個數字不變。

cues.en: So the T value doesn't change.
cues.zh: t 值不變。

cues.en: Square root of N doesn't change, but the sample standard deviation is changing.

cues.en: So sometimes we just happen to pick a sample at by chance that is a little bit more widely distributed.
cues.zh: 有時剛好選到分布更寬的樣本。

cues.en: So what I'm doing now is just rerunning this code and seeing if we get any, oh, there you go.
cues.zh: 不斷重跑，喔，有了。

cues.en: Look at that.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: Now the, the true mean is well outside the 95% confidence interval.
cues.zh: 現在真正平均遠在 95% 區間之外。

cues.en: So this is an illustration of the fact that the confidence interval doesn't require, it doesn't mean that the true mean is contained within the sample
cues.zh: 這說明，信賴區間並不要求、並不表示真正平均一定包含在樣本平均

cues.en: mean plus the 95% confidence interval.
cues.zh: 加上 95% 區間內。

cues.en: The 95% confidence interval is really about our confidence in the precision of this sample mean with regard to lots and lots of other experiments,
cues.zh: 95% 區間真正關心的是，對樣本平均相對許多其他實驗的精密程度，有多少信心，

cues.zh: 樣本大小為 50。

cues.en: Let's see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: So here I take random samples and then I compute the mean and the standard deviation and the confidence interval.
cues.zh: 隨機抽樣，再計算平均、標準差和區間。

cues.en: This code here, these four lines of code here is the same as what you saw above.
cues.zh: 這四行和上面相同。

cues.en: And then what I'm doing is determining whether the true mean is inside this confidence interval.
cues.zh: 再判斷真正平均是否在區間內。

cues.en: So we store the mean and the standard deviation of the random sample from our population because of course we need these two variables in the formula
cues.zh: 儲存這兩個變數，因為計算信賴區間的公式

cues.en: So we have the mean plus inverse T distribution, and then we have these two numbers here.

cues.en: In fact, the confidence interval is really just telling us about our confidence on the estimation of the sample mean.
cues.zh: 真正告訴我們，對樣本平均估計的信心。

cues.en: It's telling us that if we repeat this experiment a large number of times, then about 95% of those times, many of these times of these experiment repetitions,
cues.zh: 如果重複實驗很多次，大約 95% 的時候，在很多重複實驗中，

cues.en: we are going to have the true mean within the sample mean plus this confidence interval.
cues.zh: 真正平均會落在樣本平均加上區間內。

cues.en: But that doesn't mean that in this particular sample that's going to be the case.
cues.zh: 但不表示這個特定樣本一定如此。

cues.en: So we can run this again.
cues.zh: 再跑。

cues.en: And you see that many times it happens to be that the true mean is contained within the sample mean plus 95% confidence interval.
cues.zh: 很多時候，真正平均剛好在樣本平均加上 95% 區間內。

cues.en: You can also see that these confidence intervals are varying in width as I keep rerunning this code.
cues.zh: 重跑時，也能看到區間寬度改變。

cues.en: Sometimes they're narrower and sometimes they're wider.
cues.zh: 有時窄，有時寬。

cues.en: And that's because if we go up here, so this value doesn't change, T star doesn't change, sample size doesn't change, but the numerator
cues.zh: 因為這個值不變，t 星號、樣本數不變，但分子的

cues.en: of this fraction here does change from run to run.
cues.zh: 這一項每次會變。

cues.en: Because sometimes we're gonna happen to pick samples that are more variable and sometimes we're gonna happen to pick samples that are less variable.
cues.zh: 有時剛好選到變異大、或變異小的樣本。

cues.en: So now I'm just kind of, I'm rerunning this code over and over again, kind of qualitatively just poking around randomly and seeing what happens.
cues.zh: 現在只是一直重跑，定性、隨機嘗試，看會怎樣。

cues.en: But it would be nice to do this a little more rigorously, a little more quantitatively.
cues.zh: 但如果更嚴謹、定量一點會很好。

cues.en: And that's what I'm doing here in this piece of code here.
cues.zh: 這段程式就是如此。

cues.en: So what I do is repeat exactly what I've done above.
cues.zh: 重複上面完全相同操作。

cues.en: So I take random samples of the population, I compute the mean and the sample standard deviation, and then here I compute the confidence interval.
cues.zh: 隨機從母體抽樣、計算平均和樣本標準差，再計算區間。

cues.en: And now what's different here compared to what you already saw above is that I'm saying if the population mean is greater than the lower bound
cues.zh: 不同的是，如果母體平均大於區間下界，

cues.en: of the confidence interval, and if the population mean is less than the upper bound of the confidence interval, then I'm going to set this new variable within ci,
cues.zh: 且小於上界，就設定新變數 withinci，

cues.en: within confidence interval.
cues.zh: 也就是在信賴區間內。

cues.en: For this experiment, we're looping over experiments.
cues.zh: 對這次實驗，我們在遍歷實驗。

cues.en: Set that to be one.
cues.zh: 設為 1。

cues.en: So you can see we are re-running our experiment 5,000 times.
cues.zh: 可見重做 5000 次。

cues.en: In this case, using a sample size of 50 is a little bit larger than above.
cues.zh: 這次樣本數 50，比上面稍大。

cues.en: And that's going to tell us the number of times of the number of samples where the true population mean was contained within the confidence interval.
cues.zh: 告訴我們有多少次、多少個樣本，真正母體平均包含在區間內。

cues.en: And in this case it happened to be around 92.5% of the samples plus the confidence intervals contain the true population mean.
cues.zh: 這次大約 92.5% 的樣本加區間，包含真正母體平均。
